GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 4l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off all clear, battled on one pace # did enough
Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, took over passing 200m, drew half clear b4 joined passing 100m and headed 50m., # had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from the 400m until shifting outwards and making contact, to secure clear running near the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off all clear, half off 200m, took over 100m, drew clear late # had run/did enough
Jumped Ok drifted back 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well making good ground, limited room late # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted behind rnrs from a wide barrier.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down 5th Four Wide 5 Lengths Out On A Limb (with 1st following 5 Wide Out On A Limb ), within 3 Lengths x 600m kept on tough to 200m Couldn'T Go On had no favours but had # similar task as 1st
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 4th, 3 Lengths @ 800m. enjoyed good trail to turn . Ridden Along into Clear Soon After Straightening Up . Never Stopped Trying . $3 Winner Led All The Way carrying 5.5 kilos less # good in defeat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted in and made contact. Commenced to race keenly near the 800m and shortly after shifted out slightly before being bumped and carried back in, and then had to be steadied after becoming awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok laned box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and faded # weak run home
Jumped Ok sat box seat 1 length off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on strong to the line # had run/good

Debut for stable. Jumped well. Not pushed early & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead). Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed out 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & gave ground in last 200m. Vetted - bled 1st time. # Bled 1st time.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam reveaed the gelding to have bled from both nostrils. Tnr was advised, as it was the first occasion, the gelding would now be subject to the embargoes under AR79(4). Since passed gallop at Hawkesbury 28/11/25.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Outside 4th 3l. peeled 3 Wide looming Turn . hung out touch. Straightened Up 2-3l away and Battled On Well in fight for minors # sound/no match 1st
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung out when placed under pressure rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased Inside 3rd 2l. Under Good Hold camped on Leaders back to Turn . Saved Ground railing under Leader into Straight and Quickly Took over. Battled On Well but Collared 150m, faded to line. fitter # hit front/faded
